documents.description: In this insightful podcast interview hosted by Tigist Waltenigus, Shega Generation founder Samuel Geremew dives deep into the hidden dangers of social media, digital security, and the psychological impact of cyberbullying. The conversation explores critical topics such as social engineering, phishing and fake links ("bone for meat" psychological traps), strong password practices, protecting digital privacy, and how Shega Generation equips youth with essential digital literacy and cybersecurity consciousness.

documents.quote: "As a person becomes smarter and more digital, their vulnerability often increases unless paired with true digital literacy and cybersecurity awareness."

documents.description: Founder Samuel Geremew—higher education university lecturer, Ambassador for MaryJoy NGO, and CEO of Samilos Media—launched Shega Generation under the motto 'Share our knowledge in kindness.' Gathering a few bright children from different neighborhoods, he began teaching university-level computer science concepts inside his sister Weyn's traditional coffee house on small wooden stools on Sunday mornings.
documents.quote: We started on small wooden stools in my sister Weyn's coffee shop. We had no fancy labs, but we had unlimited curiosity and a spirit of kindness.
documents.title: The Coffee House Genesis (Weyn Coffee)

documents.description: Word spread quickly across the community. The young kids caught on so fast that early cohort members naturally transformed into mentors for new joiners. Sunday morning sessions expanded to full capacity as students began building basic web pages and solving mathematical logic puzzles.
documents.quote: The magic happened when 10-year-olds who learned Scratch and Ge'ez counting the year before started teaching the new 7-year-olds.
documents.title: Peer Mentorship & Organic Expansion

documents.description: Due to personal circumstances, Weyn Coffee House was forced to close. Refusing to let the movement end, Samuel initiated strategic discussions with the Tourism Training Institute (TTI). Gracious leadership at TTI offered venue space at Guenet Hotel, launching the historic 1st Shega Generation Summer Camp.
documents.quote: When the coffee house closed, I refused to let our kids' dreams stop. TTI stepped up and opened the doors of Guenet Hotel.
documents.title: 1st Summer Camp at Guenet Hotel

documents.description: The 2nd Summer Camp scaled significantly across both Guenet Hotel and the main TTI institute campus. TTI leadership and staff enrolled their own children into Shega Generation, forging a deep institutional bond and adding structured hospitality etiquette into the curriculum.
documents.quote: When staff at TTI enrolled their own children into our classes, we knew we were building something truly special.
documents.title: 2nd Summer Camp (Guenet Hotel & TTI Campus)

documents.description: TTI officially unlocked state-of-the-art computer laboratories for Shega Generation students. Kids practiced Python programming, AI command engineering, and full-stack web development hands-on on high-performance desktop workstations.
documents.quote: Moving from wooden stools to full-fledged computer laboratories gave our students the exact tools needed to build real-world software.
documents.title: 3rd Summer Camp at TTI (Computer Labs Unlocked)

documents.description: Today, Shega Generation operates active cohorts inside TTI smart classrooms and computer labs. Senior students run a Commercial Software Lab executing paid client software builds, while national broadcasts on Fana FM and Samilos Media showcase youth innovations.
documents.location: TTI Smart Classrooms & National Media Outlets
documents.quote: Our students aren't just learning—they are executing commercial client contracts and broadcasting their projects nationally.
documents.title: Smart Classrooms & Commercial Student Software Lab

documents.description: The ultimate vision: Building a dedicated, permanent 24/7 Shega Innovation Campus in Addis Ababa—equipped with overnight coding labs, startup incubation facilities, rest spaces, hardware workshops, and multi-tier cohort capacity reachable from every corner of Ethiopia.
documents.quote: A safe, fear-free sanctuary where Ethiopia's brightest minds can practice overnight, build startups, and solve real-world problems.
documents.title: The Shega Innovation Campus & Nationwide Reach
